title: specbackfill pilot scorecard record
description: Public-safe normalized record for scoring deterministic companion obligations over real-diff pilots. Store only anonymized labels, operator verdicts, and aggregate-safe notes; do not store raw private diffs, PR bodies, review text, personal data, or secrets.

sample_id.description: Stable anonymized row ID for the pilot sample. Use an opaque public-safe label such as S001.

source_label.description: Opaque repository or corpus label. Use anonymized labels such as repo-a or corpus-01; do not use private repository names, URLs, paths, or personal identifiers in committed scorecards.

sample_ref.description: Opaque PR, diff, or changed-file-group label. Use anonymized labels such as diff-001; do not use PR titles, URLs, raw paths, or proprietary identifiers in committed scorecards.

obligation_id.description: Deterministic obligation ID, normally from obligations.v1 or local_ai_review_import.v1.

was_actioned.description: True only when operator_verdict is useful_fixed. useful_fixed rows must set this true.

duplicate_with_local_ai_review.description: True only when local-ai-review independently produced the same actionable concern before consuming specbackfill output.

duplicate_with_review_firewall.description: True only when a pre-existing review or CI signal already contained the same actionable concern and review-firewall triaged that signal.

evidence_ok.description: True when the row's deterministic output had concrete diff-local evidence the operator could inspect.

status_reason_ok.description: True when satisfied/suppressed status reasons were visible enough to score. Use true for missing rows unless status explanation was confusing.

notes.description: Short public-safe note. Do not include raw private review text, private diff excerpts, URLs, email-like values, secrets, or proprietary identifiers.
